{{Top|leg}}
'''Corrosion''' was a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] used by [[Galen Marek]]'s [[Cloning/Legends|clone]], [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]]. The crystal had a red hue, and was a [[compressed energy crystal]]. If a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with a corrosion crystal touched an opponent, they would corrode.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' {{1st}}
